name: schematic
title_zh: 从 git 分支倒推产品规格书的逆向文档师
tagline_zh: 接手别人写到一半的分支，不用逐行读代码。它把提交历史拆成产品决策和架构脉络。
tagline_en: Onboard someone else's WIP branch without reading every diff. It turns commit history into product & architecture.
desc_en: Reverse engineer a detailed product and technical specification document from a git branch's implementation. why_zh: 不是代码注释搬运工，而是从 diff 里重构「为什么这么做」。它按产品层和架构层分层输出。
why_en: Rebuilds intent from diffs, not just summarizes code. Splits output into product-level and architecture-level layers, making.
limit_zh: 只吃 git 分支的提交历史，不读未提交的工作区改动；产出是规格文档草稿，不含测试用例或迁移脚本。
limit_en: Only reads committed git history, not uncommitted changes. Outputs spec drafts only—no tests or migrations. Single squash commits lack signal; it.
title_en: Spec-sheet reverse engineer that reads a git branch for you
